category: Security — Authentication Bypassed in Production Code
description: App.tsx line 41 replaces real Firebase Authentication with a hardcoded dev user: const [user, setUser] = useState<any>({ uid: 'dev-user' }). The login guard on line 95 (if (!user)) is always false because user is initialized with a non-null value. Firebase Auth events in rootStore.ts are now bypassed — onAuthStateChanged is wired but its result is never reflected in App.tsx's user state. The LoginView is never rendered. This dev shortcut was committed to main, meaning any deployed build accepts any visitor as an authenticated user. Combined with the already-permissive Firestore rules, this creates open read/write access to the database.

The pull introduced two parallel state systems that both manage overlapping concerns and are imported simultaneously. App.tsx imports useConservatoryStore (Zustand) for processVoiceInput, commitAction, pendingAction, researchProgress AND imports useConservatory (rootStore) via useEntities/useEvents hooks. PlaygroundScreen imports useConservatory() AND useConservatoryStore() in the same component. Both stores implement processVoiceInput with different codepaths (Zustand version lacks strategy/ambiguity handling). Both implement enrichEntity with different Firestore write patterns. Both implement commitAction/commitPendingAction with different business logic. This split-brain creates inconsistent behavior: voice commands go through different code depending on which store the caller uses. There is no single source of truth.

category: Architecture — CommonJS require() in ESM Module
description: services/store/rootStore.ts lines 130-132 use require() for dynamic imports inside an ESM module: const { entityRepo } = require('./repositories/EntityRepository') and const { eventRepo } = require('./repositories/EventRepository'). Vite's ESM build does not support CommonJS require() calls in source files. This is a latent runtime crash waiting to occur when initFirestoreSync() is called after a user logs in. The correct pattern for dynamic ESM imports is await import('./repositories/EntityRepository').
